reason: The README clearly describes an agent-facing image generation tool that calls configured Qwen and Volcano Ark providers and returns generated image URLs.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供调用阿里云通义千问或火山方舟服务生成图片的 image_generate 工具，支持文生图及部分图生图参数。
summaries.en: Provides an image_generate tool for agents to create images through configured Qwen or Volcano Ark providers, with text-to-image and limited reference-image support.

capabilities: Registers an image_generate tool for agent use
Sends image-generation requests to configured Qwen or Volcano Ark APIs
Supports text-to-image generation and, for Volcano, reference-image generation
